name: Ascension
audio: bubbling glass and a slow sinister swell, a hissing dragon breath and clinking vials; no speech
world: The laboratory is alive: alembics bubble, fumes and glowing droplets drift, coiled pipes hiss, magenta and lime light pulses along the shelves and mist curls over the stone.

actions.beat: The alembics along the walls bubble over and luminous fumes pour across the stone floor, flasks flashing lime and magenta.
{{She}} lifts a glowing vial between two fingers and raises the staff as the great flask roils and the mist swirls up around {{her}}, {{her}} hair lifting in the fumes.
Venomis coils out of the shadows and lowers its head over {{her}} shoulder as the mist rolls on, and {{she}} turns a sly, knowing look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
